d:
Some dogs arrive with painful pasts, but that doesn’t mean their stories have to end there. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres and her team take in pit bulls and sick dogs who need more than a safe place to stay. From injured dogs to frightened animals struggling to trust people, every rescue brings a different challenge and a chance to start again.
The team works to help each dog recover and prepare for dog adoption. The road to a new life can be long, but every dog deserves the chance to be loved. Will these pit bulls find the people willing to give them that second chance?
